hooks.command: P=$(cat); case "$P" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$R/agent-worker/run_tests.py" ] || exit 0; PY="$R/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$R/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/wt-precommit-$$-$RANDOM"; mkdir -p "$T" || exit 0; (cd "$R/agent-worker" && LOG_TO_FILE=0 SETTINGS_PATH="$T/s.json" SECRETS_PATH="$T/x.json" ADMIN_AUTH_PATH="$T/a.json" CALLS_PATH="$T/c" LISTENERS_PATH="$T/l.json" LISTENER_SAMPLE_INTERVAL=0 "$PY" run_tests.py >"$T/out.txt" 2>&1); S=$?; rm -rf "$T" 2>/dev/null; [ $S -eq 0 ] && exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"test_sidecar is red, so this commit was blocked. CI runs the same suite before building an image, so it would not have shipped anyway. Run the suite (see the talkwave-test skill), fix the failures, then commit again."},"systemMessage":"Commit blocked: test_sidecar is failing."}'

P=$(cat); case "$P" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$R/agent-worker/version.py" ] || exit 0; C=$(cd "$R" && git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); case "$P" in *' -a'*|*'--all'*) C="$C
$(cd "$R" && git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null)" ;; esac; printf '%s' "$C" | grep -qE '^(agent-worker|web-widget)/' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$C" | grep -q '^agent-worker/version\.py$' && exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"This commit changes shipped code under agent-worker/ or web-widget/ but does not touch agent-worker/version.py. version.py exists so two containers running the same image can be told apart, and three commits in one afternoon shipped as duplicate versions because the bump was left to memory. Bump APP_VERSION and stage it, or if this genuinely ships nothing, say so and commit again with version.py untouched by removing the code change from the staged set."},"systemMessage":"Commit blocked: shipped code changed without bumping version.py."}'
